Kritickou rychlost zatím neznáme: potřeb: Critical speed isn't known yet: it needs at least one genuinely fast effort (3–6 min) and a longer continuous run with watch segments in the last 90 days.
Rychlost: minuty běhu rychleji než 1,1 ×: Speed: minutes of running faster than 1.1 × your critical speed (roughly 3 km race pace and faster), from the run's segments. Strides shorter than 20 s don't show up in the watch segments.
